findings.note: Oilers team site, Nov 20: Nugent-Hopkins missed Friday's practice and may miss a fourth straight game, while Edmonton finishes a six-game road trip with a back-to-back and three games in four days. Carolina looks fully healthy.

ESPN's game page shows Carolina averaging 33.0 shots for and 21.6 against, versus Edmonton's 24.8 and 26.4. Kochetkov has a .920 save percentage, compared with .906 for Levi and .912 for Jarry. Andersen is on IR.

Jonathan Davis of VSiN bets a half unit on the Oilers moneyline at +150. He notes that Edmonton won the October meeting 6-5 in a shootout and that McDavid has a nine-game point streak against Carolina.
